rationale: C13 is expressly identified by the child as the June 22 communication and supplies its substantive foundation. Both memoranda address the same nationwide fall Community Chest/United Fund campaign, Federal cooperation across departments and communities, employee solicitation and installment payments, and support for the United Defense Fund, including USO services, defense-affected communities, and Korean relief. The child functions as a follow-up that adds a Federal vice-chairman and detailed implementation arrangements. C09 is also closely related and shares campaign machinery, but concerns the National Capital Area rather than the nationwide program. C23 uses similar Federal charitable-campaign administration but for the Red Cross.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under date of June 22, 1953 I addressed a communication to you regarding cooperation of the Federal government in the fall campaigns of Community Chests and United Funds
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Community Chests and United Funds all over the country will conduct their annual campaigns this fall... I have assured the leaders of United Community Campaigns of the cooperation of the Federal government
shared_material.explanation: The child explicitly refers back to C13 and reiterates its campaign and Federal-cooperation framework.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all employes of the Federal government in communities throughout the United States and its territories and possessions may have the opportunity to subscribe and to pay their subscriptions over an extended period
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the full cooperation of your department in each community throughout the United States and its territories and possessions... the effective solicitation of all employees and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C13's concrete nationwide employee-solicitation and installment-payment machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The service of the USO to the armed forces, help to communities overwhelmed by defense activities and relief to Korea are all provided... through the United Defense Fund.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the United Defense Fund whose job it is to furnish USO services to the armed forces, help to communities disrupted by defense activities and relief to Korea
shared_material.explanation: This is near-verbatim, distinctive shared language describing the campaign's beneficiaries.
